capabilities: Write Canvas and edge links into note properties
Search Canvas cards with query syntax
OCR images and index PDF text locally
Split a card into a tree of cards by heading
Add notes to a Canvas by tag query
disambiguation: Not a diagramming or mind-mapping tool; it adds search, property sync, and card operations on top of the existing Canvas format.
extras: OCR runs locally: macOS uses Vision via osascript, Windows offers a ~60 MB PaddleOCR WebGPU download or Windows OCR, Linux uses built-in OCR; phones and tablets index PDFs only and receive image text through sync files in the config folder. Index and downloaded models live in Obsidian's IndexedDB outside the vault and are not removed on uninstall. Scanned PDFs without a text layer are not searched, and Find in Canvas binds Cmd/Ctrl+F, overriding the core Search current file hotkey.
intentEvidence: This Obsidian plugin enhances Obsidian Canvas with features I find essential.
problem: Obsidian Canvas connections exist only inside the .canvas file, so notes cannot show which Canvases or notes they are linked to, and Canvas cards cannot be searched by their text or by text inside images and PDFs.
summary: Canvas enhancement plugin that syncs Canvas links and edges into note properties and adds card search, OCR/PDF text search, and card tools.
